name: Jelly 5
description: Native Jellyfin and Emby media client for PS5 homebrew with a custom liquid-glass interface, hardware-decoded 4K HDR playback, H.264, HEVC and AV1 support, subtitles, multiple audio tracks, Jellyfin SyncPlay, HDMI audio bitstreaming, music playback, Seerr integration and DualSense-friendly controls.
author: 02dnot
